tiny-yaml

A 5kb YAML 1.2 parser for browsers and Node, with zero dependencies.

Installation

npm install tiny-yaml

Usage

import { parse } from 'tiny-yaml';

const doc = parse('foo: bar\nbaz:\n  - 1\n  - 2');
console.log(doc.foo); // 'bar'
console.log(doc.baz); // [1, 2]

Why?

Existing YAML libraries are large and pull in big dependency trees. tiny-yaml covers the YAML 1.2 core schema in a single file and is suitable for use in size-constrained environments like Chrome extensions and edge functions.

What is not supported

  • Custom tags beyond the core schema
  • Streaming parse for very large documents
  • YAML 1.1 boolean coercion (yes/no, on/off)
